verified_facts: OSGM15 is the OS vertical transformation model used with OS Net/OSTN15 context
OSGM15 error excludes GNSS heighting error
Great Britain OSGM15 standard error is 0.008m
regional vertical-datum errors differ outside mainland Great Britain
OS Net station height coordinate error is a separate component
vertical datum transformation error is not terrain-surface RMSE
candidate height values must state their vertical datum
EA/OS height comparison must use compatible vertical-datum interpretation
quality_effect: Keeps OSGM15 vertical transformation error separate from LIDAR/Terrain50 surface-model error.
